localChanges: Tagging `base-trade-rate-research` changes that entity's ids, because `idProvider` keys on the tag — so the state hash and the DTO byte counts move.

That was verified rather than assumed. Dumping the turn-50 DTO before and after, normalising every id out, and comparing showed exactly one difference: `Research-N` became `ResearchTradeRate-N`. No value, object, yield or rule count changed, and `_` still reports `Research`, so nothing the renderer or the translations read has moved.
New baseline: 5fa259b4 / 6aa06238 / f16d1f77, deterministic across runs. The note in the fixture records the cause, since a checksum change with no explanation is worth less than no checksum at all.
